note.title: Healthy living and lifestyle
note.specFocus: diet, exercise, wellbeing, habits and giving advice
note.sourcePages: Original practice material written around common GCSE-style language themes; not official exam-board material.
note.summary:
1.2 Healthy living and lifestyle
Key focus
- diet, exercise, wellbeing, habits and giving advice.

Core language
- Useful structures: secondo me; penso che; mi piace perché; l’anno scorso; in futuro; di solito; dovrei/dovremmo.
- Use time frequency phrases, modal expressions for advice, and connect opinions with clear reasons.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Keep nouns and adjectives in agreement, use the correct article, and preserve the tense of each English sentence.
questions.modelAnswer: Faccio nuoto due volte alla settimana perché mi rilassa.
questions.question:
Translate into Italian:

I swim twice a week because it relaxes me.

questions.examTip: Keep nouns and adjectives in agreement, use the correct article, and preserve the tense of each English sentence.
questions.modelAnswer: Di solito a colazione mangio yogurt con frutta e bevo acqua.
questions.question:
Translate into Italian:

I usually eat yoghurt with fruit for breakfast and drink water.

questions.examTip: Keep nouns and adjectives in agreement, use the correct article, and preserve the tense of each English sentence.
questions.modelAnswer: Quando ero piccolo mangiavo troppi dolci e non facevo sport.
questions.question:
Translate into Italian:

When I was little, I ate too many sweets and did no sport.

questions.examTip: Keep nouns and adjectives in agreement, use the correct article, and preserve the tense of each English sentence.
questions.modelAnswer: Dopo scuola cammino fino a casa invece di prendere l’autobus.
questions.question:
Translate into Italian:

After school I walk home instead of taking the bus.

questions.examTip: Keep nouns and adjectives in agreement, use the correct article, and preserve the tense of each English sentence.
questions.modelAnswer: Ieri mi sentivo molto stanco perché avevo dormito poche ore.
questions.question:
Translate into Italian:

Yesterday I felt very tired because I had slept only a few hours.

questions.examTip: Keep nouns and adjectives in agreement, use the correct article, and preserve the tense of each English sentence.
questions.modelAnswer: In futuro vorrei smettere di mangiare patatine e dormire di più.
questions.question:
Translate into Italian:

In the future I would like to stop eating crisps and sleep more.

questions.examTip: Cover every bullet, use a past and a future reference where relevant, and support each opinion with perché.
questions.modelAnswer:
Faccio nuoto due volte alla settimana perché mi rilassa. Di solito a colazione mangio yogurt con frutta e bevo acqua. Quando ero piccolo mangiavo troppi dolci e non facevo sport. Secondo me è importante e vorrei provare un’esperienza diversa in futuro.

(English translation: I swim twice a week because it relaxes me. I usually eat yoghurt with fruit for breakfast and drink water. When I was little, I ate too many sweets and did no sport. In my opinion it is important, and I would like to try a different experience in the future.)
